newsitem.title: ITALY: Racehorses seized in Italian crime swoop.
newsitem.headline: Racehorses seized in Italian crime swoop.

text.p: Police confiscated 41 racehorses on Friday in an operation to seize the assets of a suspected crime clan.
The mounts, kept at two stables, belonged to suspected members of the Casalesi clan of the Camorra, the Naples area equivalent of the Sicilian Mafia, police said.
They were seized on the orders of the DIA anti-Mafia squad.
A suspected senior member of the Casalesi clan, Nicola Alfiero, is being held in detention on suspicion of drugs trafficking.
One of the stables was registered in his name and the other in the name of a suspected front company, police said.
Police in Italy have powers to seize the assets of suspected Mafiosi to crack down on money laundering.
